metadata.description: cross-product cone table over four QUITS assemblies

clean.read_sets: hand-declared, idealised: every component reads only its own coordinate
clean.edges: none (all five dimension components are leaves)
clean.faithfulness: not faithful to the source; it is the deliberately minimal contrast baseline
clean.note: kept so the pre-2026-10-09 numbers stay reproducible

quits_faithful.read_sets: hand-declared, plus the H1 counterexample: the extractor declares reads=('code',) but its registry lookup also reads the `extractor` coordinate
quits_faithful.faithfulness: a *counterexample*, not a model of QUITS: it shows what Theorem 3 reports when a component under-declares
quits_faithful.note: the only assembly with unbounded cones by construction

quits_dataflow.read_sets: hand-declared conservative H3 model: R(extractor) contains `noise` (build_circuit bakes the error model into the circuit) and R(decoder) is everything embedded in the circuit plus its own coordinate
quits_dataflow.edges: hand-set, deliberately over-approximating: extractor <- (code, noise); decoder <- (code, extractor, arch, noise); arch <- code (added 2026-10-09 -- the dynamic measurement shows a code substitution changes `layout_positions`, so this edge is real)
quits_dataflow.faithfulness: conservative over-approximation of the source, and still *wider* than the auto-extracted one
quits_dataflow.note: kept as the hand-modelled counterpart of `source_faithful`

source_faithful.read_sets: auto-extracted from the pinned QUITS tree by experiments/extract_read_sets.py (READ_SETS_FROM_SOURCE)
source_faithful.edges: auto-derived: ARTIFACT_READS_FROM_SOURCE minus self-loops (ASSEMBLY_EDGES_FROM_SOURCE): extractor <- code, arch <- code, decoder <- (code, extractor)
source_faithful.faithfulness: faithful by construction (AST-extracted), cross-validated against the dynamic measurements in experiments/dynamic_impact.json

trigger2_risk.description: Verdict on the published baseline `source_faithful`: **bounded** (0/240 substitutions unbounded, 240/240 certified applicable). Cone sizes on that baseline: code=[4], extractor=[2], arch=[1], noise=[1], decoder=[1]. The contrast columns isolate *why* an assembly can be unbounded: `clean` has 0/240 and `quits_dataflow` has 0/240, while the hand-built H1 counterexample `quits_faithful` has 48/240 — every one of them in the `extractor` dimension, because that component declares reads=('code',) while its registry lookup also reads the `extractor` coordinate, so (C1)/(C2) fail and Theorem 3 reports observed ⊄ declared. Faithfulness *alone* therefore does not cause unboundedness; an under-declared read set does. On the baseline the checker certifies locality for every configuration and dimension, so PLAN §9 trigger 2 (the theorem being only stateable as 're-verify everything') is NOT hit.
